meta.title: {appName}: bills of quantities from IFC models
meta.description: Drop in a building model, choose how you measure, and get a bill of quantities in Excel. Every number shows its formula and the elements behind it.

hero.label: IFC → BoQ · bills of quantities from the model
hero.title: Quantities you can check.
hero.lead: Drop in a building model, choose how you measure, and get a bill of quantities in Excel. Every number shows its formula and the elements behind it.

what.label: No. 01 — What it is
what.title: A measuring engine that shows its work.
what.lead: {appName} reads an IFC model and writes the bill of quantities a quantity surveyor would, then shows how it got every number.

traceable.title: Every number is traceable
traceable.body: Open any quantity: the formula, the values it used and the elements in the model it came from.

asks.title: It asks instead of guessing
asks.body: A wall with two thicknesses, a name it doesn't know: it asks you, once. The answer is kept for next time.

rules.title: Your firm's rules
rules.body: Measure the way your firm measures. Rules, item codes and texts are your data, versioned and editable.

revisions.title: Revisions are cheap
revisions.body: A new model version reuses every answer. Re-measuring takes minutes, and the changes are listed line by line.

upload.title: Upload the model
upload.body: An IFC file from any authoring tool. Several discipline models can make one BoQ.

measure.title: Choose how you measure
measure.body: Pick a rule set and a classification. The engine measures every element under them.

answer.title: Answer what it can't tell
answer.body: Unclear names and values become short questions, each with a suggested answer.

excel.title: Take it to Excel
excel.body: Sections, subtotals and a trace of every line. Edit it there and bring the changes back.

calc.label: No. 03 — How it is calculated
calc.title: Pick any line. See where it came from.
calc.caption: Sample bill of quantities lines from the Duplex model

rows.wall: Wall, Exterior – Brick on Block, 417 mm

calc.heading: How it is calculated
calc.rounded: Rounded as the rule set says
calc.footnote: From the Duplex sample, a real building model. On it the engine matches a hand-measured BoQ line for line.

items.modelled: It measures what is in the model. Work that isn't modelled, such as earthworks, plaster or scaffolding, is in the BoQ only if your rules derive it or you add it.
items.standards: It ships no standard's rules or texts and never claims a BoQ complies with one. You bring your own.
items.formats: Reads IFC2x3 and IFC4. Tested on 309 files from 30 authoring tools.
items.draft: The result is a draft that a qualified person checks and approves.

access.title: Measure your next model with {appName}.
access.body: {appName} is in a private pilot. Request access with your work email, and we'll send you a link to start.
